text.en: These Rules may be cited as the Legal Profession (Accountant’s Report) Rules.

An accountant shall be qualified to give an account’s report on behalf of an advocate and solicitor, in accordance with the provisions of section 24, if he is a qualified person for the purpose of the Companies (Authorised Auditors) Rules (S 22/1997) and possesses associate membership of one of the bodies listed in rule 3(a).
Any accountant’s report shall be in the form set out in the Schedule. 6 Legal Profession
